stem: What percentage of children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) are estimated to have an underlying sleep disorder?
explanation: The lecturer mentions that about $25\%$ of children with ADHD may have an underlying sleep disorder.
rationale: The value represents one out of every four children diagnosed with ADHD.

optionExplanations.A: This is the prevalence of general snoring, but the overlap with ADHD is significantly higher.
optionExplanations.B: The lecturer mentions that about $25\%$ of children with ADHD may have an underlying sleep disorder.
optionExplanations.C: While a significant number, the estimate provided in the source is specifically a quarter of the ADHD population.
optionExplanations.D: This figure represents the upper range of general OSA prevalence, but the correlation with ADHD symptoms is higher.

source.hint: The value represents one out of every four children diagnosed with ADHD.
